title: digest_canon
description: Digest projection of a canonical registry file (canon/**/*.json). Captures declared IDs, namespace prefixes, alias mappings, owners, and lifecycle fields for cross-slice ID-resolution and drift analysis.

digest_type.description: Discriminator constant identifying this as a canon digest.

source_file.description: Relative path of the source file from the toolkit root (e.g. canon/manifest.json).

source_sha.description: 40-character git blob SHA of the source file at extraction time.

extractor_version.description: Semver version of the extractor script that produced this digest.

extracted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this digest was produced.

namespace.description: Common namespace prefix shared by IDs in this file (e.g. cn:core:). Derived from the longest shared prefix of all IDs. Empty string if IDs share no common prefix.

registry_version.description: Value of the registry_version field if present.

ids.description: All canonical ID strings declared in this file (entries[*].id).

owners.description: Distinct owner values found across all entries (entries[*].owners[] flattened). Used to check ownership consistency.

aliases.description: Map of alias string → canonical ID string for all alias→id pairs in the file. Aggregated from entries[*].aliases[]. Lookup direction is alias→id (the direction resolvers need).

kinds.description: Distinct kind values found across all entries (entries[*].kind).

statuses.description: Distinct status values found across all entries (e.g. active, deprecated).

deprecated_ids.description: IDs whose status is deprecated. Used for D13 deprecation-without-replacement checks.

entry_count.description: Total number of entries in this canon file.
